summary: Grupo Aval Acciones y Valores S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting a routine interest payment on its Fifth Issuance of Notes in the Colombian peso market. The payment is made per the offering memorandum terms. This is a standard debt service obligation, not an event-driven special situation. The 6-K serves as a notice of relevant information to foreign private issuer shareholders and the SEC. No corporate action or event affecting shareholder value is involved. What to watch: no risk-arb angle; purely operational compliance.
